-- +goose Up
CREATE TABLE verdicts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    repo TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('builtin', 'greenhouse')),
    protocol TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    grant_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    target_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    review_base_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(review_base_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('clean', 'findings', 'inconclusive')),
    blocking INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blocking >= 0),
    rules_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    config_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    input_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    backend TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    findings_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    findings_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('parallel', 'gate')),
    recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK (verdict = 'findings' OR blocking = 0)
);
CREATE INDEX verdicts_task_idx ON verdicts(task_id, recorded_at DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER verdicts_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON verdicts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Verdict is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER verdicts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON verdicts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Verdict is insert-only'); END;

-- +goose Down
DROP TRIGGER verdicts_no_delete;
DROP TRIGGER verdicts_immutable;
DROP INDEX verdicts_task_idx;
DROP TABLE verdicts;

-- +goose Up
CREATE TABLE verdicts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    repo TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('builtin', 'greenhouse')),
    protocol TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    grant_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    target_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    review_base_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(review_base_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('clean', 'findings', 'inconclusive')),
    blocking INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blocking >= 0),
    rules_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    config_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    input_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    backend TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    findings_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    findings_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('parallel', 'gate')),
    recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK (verdict = 'findings' OR blocking = 0)
);
CREATE INDEX verdicts_task_idx ON verdicts(task_id, recorded_at DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER verdicts_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON verdicts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Verdict is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER verdicts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON verdicts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Verdict is insert-only'); END;

-- +goose Down
DROP TRIGGER verdicts_no_delete;
DROP TRIGGER verdicts_immutable;
DROP INDEX verdicts_task_idx;
DROP TABLE verdicts;

-- +goose Up
CREATE TABLE verdicts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    repo TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('builtin', 'greenhouse')),
    protocol TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    grant_id TEXT UNIQUE,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(head_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    target_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    review_base_sha TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(review_base_sha) IN (40, 64)),
    verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (verdict IN ('clean', 'findings', 'inconclusive')),
    blocking INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (blocking >= 0),
    rules_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    config_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    input_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    backend TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    findings_digest TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    findings_path TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    mode TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('parallel', 'gate')),
    recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK (verdict = 'findings' OR blocking = 0)
);
CREATE INDEX verdicts_task_idx ON verdicts(task_id, recorded_at DESC);
CREATE TRIGGER verdicts_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON verdicts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Verdict is immutable'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER verdicts_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON verdicts
BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Verdict is insert-only'); END;

-- +goose Down
DROP TRIGGER verdicts_no_delete;
DROP TRIGGER verdicts_immutable;
DROP INDEX verdicts_task_idx;
DROP TABLE verdicts;

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-119- Qualification is computed when read, as today: a Verdict passes only if all three hold: `mode = gate`; `verdict` is `clean`, or `verdict` is `findings` and `blocking = 0`; and `head` equals the head being published or merged now. 2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:208: - **`posse validate test|docs|lint` leaves with built-in review.** Nothing replaces it inside Posse or Greenhouse. A Project that wants tests, docs checks and lint to gate a merge puts them in its forge workflows, where they run at the exact head and cannot be self-reported. No Greenhouse host-mode pipeline stage is added.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-209- - **The Private Candidate leaves.** [O] Host mode reviews a local commit in the worktree and "Creates no private worktree, candidate ref or lease" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`). Posse refuses to push a head without a passing Verdict. "Nothing reaches the target before validation" becomes one comparison of two commit ids. The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-210- - **The merge gate is one conjunction** for a Task that requires review: the PR head equals `gated_sha`, a passing Verdict exists for that head, forge CI is green at that head, and Merge is authorized by `autonomy.merge` or the User. The first, third and fourth conditions exist today. Only the source of the second changes.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-211- - **`local` merge mode** has the Verdict and no CI. That is today's guarantee for `local` and is stated to the User at admission, not hidden.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:212: - **Documentation review** that `full-pipeline` did through `posse validate docs` is covered by Greenhouse rules ([O] the embedding example selects the rules `unslop` and `no-comments`) and by any docs job in CI.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-119- Qualification is computed when read, as today: a Verdict passes only if all three hold: `mode = gate`; `verdict` is `clean`, or `verdict` is `findings` and `blocking = 0`; and `head` equals the head being published or merged now. 2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:129: - Only Posse's own Lead-side processes (the command or the Watch) call Greenhouse. A Worker never does, which also keeps the author from requesting its own verdict.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:208: - **`posse validate test|docs|lint` leaves with built-in review.** Nothing replaces it inside Posse or Greenhouse. A Project that wants tests, docs checks and lint to gate a merge puts them in its forge workflows, where they run at the exact head and cannot be self-reported. The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-210- - **The merge gate is one conjunction** for a Task that requires review: the PR head equals `gated_sha`, a passing Verdict exists for that head, forge CI is green at that head, and Merge is authorized by `autonomy.merge` or the User. 2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-211- - **`local` merge mode** has the Verdict and no CI. That is today's guarantee for `local` and is stated to the User at admission, not hidden.

The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:637: - **Fixture home.** A synthetic `POSSE_HOME` holding Tasks of every plan version, every terminal state and every review mode, built from the existing migration fixtures and containing no real Project data. 2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-639- - **Live Task check.** An E2E upgrades the binary while one Change Task waits in `merging` and one Review Round runs, and both finish on their frozen path.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-714- | D3 | Keep "a selected skill is required", bound to the step the Task reaches | Yes (section 6.3). It preserves the 2026-11-02 enforcement decision and removes the misfit |

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:716: | D5 | Review of publication-bound Reports (spec, tickets). Greenhouse reviews committed diffs only | A spec or ticket set that needs independent review is committed as a document and reviewed as a Delivery. Report Acceptance by exact digest stays |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-717- | D6 | Workspace Projects | One host run per changed Member. Cross-Member context is lost; measure in G1 before choosing G-4 for a Workspace |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-718- | D7 | Whether to ever drop the review and validation tables | Not part of this design. They stay as read-only history. A later, separate proposal must bring a lossless export and a tested restore path |

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-731- | Skill sets become a second taxonomy | Sets are User-defined names, not a closed list, and nothing but the skill list keys on them |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:732: | Reviewer runs outside Posse's quota tracking and Profiles | `host_result.usage` is stored per Verdict; reviewer model is User config passed in `apply` |

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:208: - **`posse validate test|docs|lint` leaves with built-in review.** Nothing replaces it inside Posse or Greenhouse. A Project that wants tests, docs checks and lint to gate a merge puts them in its forge workflows, where they run at the exact head and cannot be self-reported. No Greenhouse host-mode pipeline stage is added.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-209- - **The Private Candidate leaves.** [O] Host mode reviews a local commit in the worktree and "Creates no private worktree, candidate ref or lease" (`GH:docs/embedding.md`). Posse refuses to push a head without a passing Verdict. "Nothing reaches the target before validation" becomes one comparison of two commit ids. The order under `full-pipeline` is review, publish, CI, Merge: review is the only evidence available before a push, and CI is the only evidence about tests, docs and lint.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-210- - **The merge gate is one conjunction** for a Task that requires review: the PR head equals `gated_sha`, a passing Verdict exists for that head, forge CI is green at that head, and Merge is authorized by `autonomy.merge` or the User. The first, third and fourth conditions exist today. Only the source of the second changes.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-211- - **`local` merge mode** has the Verdict and no CI. That is today's guarantee for `local` and is stated to the User at admission, not hidden.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:212: - **Documentation review** that `full-pipeline` did through `posse validate docs` is covered by Greenhouse rules ([O] the embedding example selects the rules `unslop` and `no-comments`) and by any docs job in CI.

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-39- | Do three independent Task properties replace the type? | No. Two of the three are not independent, and one cannot be declared or enforced. One optional requirement, `outcome`, replaces the type. Its default asks the Lead for nothing | 3 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:40: | What is a Task? | An assignment with a stopping condition, one Sandbox, one state and one Worker at a time. Nothing else is required to start | 4 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-41- | Where does Delivery live? | In its own record with its own states, opened by `posse publish`. `merging`, `merged` and `reported` stop being Task states | 4 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-42- | Do Kind and Profile stay separate? | Yes as mechanisms, because owner, cardinality and change cadence differ. Only Profile stays a product concept. Kind becomes "harness adapter" in prose and leaves what the User and the Lead must know | 5 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:43: | How are skills selected? | The User defines skill sets and an allowlist. The Lead picks a set and may add allowlisted skills per Task. A selected skill is required only at a step the Task reaches | 6 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-44- | Who reviews code? | Greenhouse, in host mode. Posse keeps the author, the fix loop, publish, CI, merge authority and one gate: a verdict for the exact head | 2 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-45- | When does built-in review leave? | Only after Greenhouse meets the exit criteria of section 2.6, first in a parallel run on the same heads and then as an opt-in gate | 2 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-164- | Grant reused | Greenhouse refuses; Posse records no second Verdict |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-165- | `posse` killed between `review` and reading the result | replay with the same `action_id` returns the receipt; exactly one reviewer invocation |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:166: | Daemon killed mid-review | the run parks as recovery-required; Posse raises one Notice and issues no new grant until it is resolved |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:167: | Reviewer quota pause | no Verdict; the same grant resumes; the Fix Round budget is not spent |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-168- | Task Teardown while another Task's review runs | the other review completes (process placement rule, 2.4) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-169- | Daemon protocol range excludes version 2 | Posse refuses to request a Verdict and names both ranges; Merge stays blocked, never downgraded |

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-238- ## 3. Challenge to the three Task properties
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-239- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:240: The report proposes three independent properties: the Task writes to the Project (W), a Report is required (R), the Task has a Delivery (D). The User asked whether this trades one rigid taxonomy for a combination of flags. It does, for the reasons below.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-241- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-242- ### 3.1 The eight combinations
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-290- | Whether the Lead must classify before starting | Nothing. `outcome` is optional and `open` is the default |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-291- | Completion rule and state path (`done` becomes `reported` for non-change Tasks) | `outcome` constrains the `done` check only. Every Task ends in `done` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:292: | Skill set | Skill sets chosen by the Lead, required at reached steps (section 6) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-293- | Which Dispatch Rules apply | Profile purpose and the #973 precedence (section 5.4) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-294- | Whether delivery and review text and state apply | Whether the Task opened a Delivery (section 4.3) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-303- |---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-304- | Three boolean properties (the report's proposal) | Eight combinations, two contradictory, one unenforceable flag, and the Lead decides three things instead of one |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:305: | No declaration at all; Posse only observes | The Lead loses two cheap checks that exist today: `done` without the required Report is refused (report E4.1), and a research Worker cannot push. With `autonomy.merge` on, an unrequested PR could merge |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-306- | Keep `type`, make it optional (report J10 alone) | Leaves the 174 branch sites and the coupling of skills, rules, state path and pipeline to one value |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-307- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-316- | Project, Lead, Worker, Sandbox, Pool, Signal, Notice, Decision, Autonomy, Teardown, Restore | unchanged | none |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-317- | **Task** | One assignment with a stopping condition, carried out by one Worker in one Sandbox | no type; `title` generated when absent |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:318: | **Brief** | The assignment text and `done_when`. Optional keys only restrict or select: `outcome`, `skills`, `after`, `base`, `target`, budget and Delivery policy keys | `type` no longer required; legacy keys stay readable (section 9) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-319- | **Outcome** | The optional requirement on `done`: `open`, `report` or `change` | replaces Change Task, Research Task and Review Task as kinds of Task |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-320- | **Work** | The observed fact that the Task branch differs from its base | new name for what `docs/spec.md:634` calls "unmerged work" |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:321: | **Report** | The written result and attachments, sealed as a Report Bundle at Teardown | available to every Task, required only under `outcome: report` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-322- | **Delivery** | The record of integrating a Task's Work: PR or local merge, CI observations, merge authorization, queue position, verdict requirement. Opened by `posse publish`. Has its own states | gains states and the columns that sit on `tasks` today; covers local merge, not only PRs |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-323- | **Verdict** | An insert-only record that a named reviewer judged one exact head against one target | replaces Review Task, Review Verdict, Review Round, Finding Ledger, Finding Pattern, Private Candidate as product concepts |

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-396- ### 5.3 Why it is still not understandable today, and the fix
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-397- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:398: The User's doubt is justified for a different reason: the word "kind" leaks. It appears in `posse dispatch` output, in `profile_required` help, in the Lead instructions and in `lead.profiles.<kind>`. A reader meets two nouns where only one is a choice.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-399- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-400- - Lead instructions, `posse dispatch`, `posse show` and Notices name the Profile only. The harness appears as an attribute of the Profile (`harness: codex`), never as something to select.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-430- ### 6.1 Constraints taken as given
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-431- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:432: - [O] "A role skill listed in `[skills]` is required. ... There is no setting to relax this." (`docs/skills.md`). The User chose enforcement after advice and a warning did not change Worker behaviour (report D2, commit `6bd85306`). This design keeps "selected means required" and fixes fit instead.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-433- - [O] ADR 0036 removed Lead skills from Workers because they "cost context, invited misfires and lengthened launch commands". A per-Task channel must not reopen that.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-434- - [O] Making a skill available costs its name and description; the body loads on use. The cost that hurts is the mandatory invocation of a skill that does not fit (report D2: `posse-tdd` on a docs-only Task).
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-460- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-461- 1. The Worker platform skill `posse`. The Lead-only and User-only platform skills (`posse-setup`, `posse-down`, `posse-update`) are not loaded into Workers (report J8).
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:462: 2. The set the Brief names. Without one: the set for the stated Outcome (`change` for `outcome: change`, `research` for `outcome: report`). For an `open` Task under `default = "auto"`, both sets are made available and each is required only if its step is reached (6.3).
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-463- 3. Allowlisted skills from the Brief.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-464- 4. The Profile's skills.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-466- **Defaults need no config edit.** Today's `[skills] change = [...]` and `research = [...]` are read as the sets `change` and `research`. `[skills] review` is used by the built-in reviewer until it leaves.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-467- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:468: ### 6.3 A selected skill is required at the step the Task reaches
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-469- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-470- Each skill has a step. [O] The step map already exists in code (`internal/app/skill_uses.go:28-36`). The design moves it into the skill's own metadata and limits steps to three moments Posse can observe:

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-631- | `defaults.review`, `review_loop.max_rounds`, `block_at` | kept; they configure the Delivery's Verdict requirement and Fix Round budget |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:632: | `review_loop.profile`, `auto_start`, `[skills] review`, `type = "review"` rules | used by the built-in provider; at R-1 they fail with `config_migration_required` naming `review_provider`, as the removed `no-mistakes` mode does today ([O] `CONTEXT.md`, Merge Mode) |

2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-38- |---|---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-39- | Do three independent Task properties replace the type? | No. Two of the three are not independent, and one cannot be declared or enforced. One optional requirement, `outcome`, replaces the type. Its default asks the Lead for nothing | 3 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:40: | What is a Task? | An assignment with a stopping condition, one Sandbox, one state and one Worker at a time. Nothing else is required to start | 4 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-41- | Where does Delivery live? | In its own record with its own states, opened by `posse publish`. `merging`, `merged` and `reported` stop being Task states | 4 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-42- | Do Kind and Profile stay separate? | Yes as mechanisms, because owner, cardinality and change cadence differ. Only Profile stays a product concept. Kind becomes "harness adapter" in prose and leaves what the User and the Lead must know | 5 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:43: | How are skills selected? | The User defines skill sets and an allowlist. The Lead picks a set and may add allowlisted skills per Task. A selected skill is required only at a step the Task reaches | 6 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-44- | Who reviews code? | Greenhouse, in host mode. Posse keeps the author, the fix loop, publish, CI, merge authority and one gate: a verdict for the exact head | 2 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-45- | When does built-in review leave? | Only after Greenhouse meets the exit criteria of section 2.6, first in a parallel run on the same heads and then as an opt-in gate | 2 |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-164- | Grant reused | Greenhouse refuses; Posse records no second Verdict |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-165- | `posse` killed between `review` and reading the result | replay with the same `action_id` returns the receipt; exactly one reviewer invocation |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:166: | Daemon killed mid-review | the run parks as recovery-required; Posse raises one Notice and issues no new grant until it is resolved |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:167: | Reviewer quota pause | no Verdict; the same grant resumes; the Fix Round budget is not spent |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-168- | Task Teardown while another Task's review runs | the other review completes (process placement rule, 2.4) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-169- | Daemon protocol range excludes version 2 | Posse refuses to request a Verdict and names both ranges; Merge stays blocked, never downgraded |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-198- With Greenhouse as the reviewer the three modes mean:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-199- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:200: | `defaults.review` | Evidence required | Checked |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-201- |---|---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-202- | `none` | forge CI at the gated head, for `pr` mode | before Merge, as today |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-238- ## 3. Challenge to the three Task properties
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-239- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:240: The report proposes three independent properties: the Task writes to the Project (W), a Report is required (R), the Task has a Delivery (D). The User asked whether this trades one rigid taxonomy for a combination of flags. It does, for the reasons below.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-241- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-242- ### 3.1 The eight combinations
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-290- | Whether the Lead must classify before starting | Nothing. `outcome` is optional and `open` is the default |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-291- | Completion rule and state path (`done` becomes `reported` for non-change Tasks) | `outcome` constrains the `done` check only. Every Task ends in `done` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:292: | Skill set | Skill sets chosen by the Lead, required at reached steps (section 6) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-293- | Which Dispatch Rules apply | Profile purpose and the #973 precedence (section 5.4) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-294- | Whether delivery and review text and state apply | Whether the Task opened a Delivery (section 4.3) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-303- |---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-304- | Three boolean properties (the report's proposal) | Eight combinations, two contradictory, one unenforceable flag, and the Lead decides three things instead of one |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:305: | No declaration at all; Posse only observes | The Lead loses two cheap checks that exist today: `done` without the required Report is refused (report E4.1), and a research Worker cannot push. With `autonomy.merge` on, an unrequested PR could merge |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-306- | Keep `type`, make it optional (report J10 alone) | Leaves the 174 branch sites and the coupling of skills, rules, state path and pipeline to one value |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-307- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-316- | Project, Lead, Worker, Sandbox, Pool, Signal, Notice, Decision, Autonomy, Teardown, Restore | unchanged | none |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-317- | **Task** | One assignment with a stopping condition, carried out by one Worker in one Sandbox | no type; `title` generated when absent |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:318: | **Brief** | The assignment text and `done_when`. Optional keys only restrict or select: `outcome`, `skills`, `after`, `base`, `target`, budget and Delivery policy keys | `type` no longer required; legacy keys stay readable (section 9) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-319- | **Outcome** | The optional requirement on `done`: `open`, `report` or `change` | replaces Change Task, Research Task and Review Task as kinds of Task |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-320- | **Work** | The observed fact that the Task branch differs from its base | new name for what `docs/spec.md:634` calls "unmerged work" |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:321: | **Report** | The written result and attachments, sealed as a Report Bundle at Teardown | available to every Task, required only under `outcome: report` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-322- | **Delivery** | The record of integrating a Task's Work: PR or local merge, CI observations, merge authorization, queue position, verdict requirement. Opened by `posse publish`. Has its own states | gains states and the columns that sit on `tasks` today; covers local merge, not only PRs |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-323- | **Verdict** | An insert-only record that a named reviewer judged one exact head against one target | replaces Review Task, Review Verdict, Review Round, Finding Ledger, Finding Pattern, Private Candidate as product concepts |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-383- | Test | Kind | Profile | Source |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-384- |---|---|---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:385: | What question it answers | How does Posse launch, resume, steer, interrupt and notify this CLI? | Which model at which effort does the User want, and what continues its Tasks when quota runs out? | [O] `internal/config/config.go:141-178` |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:386: | Fields | 13, all adapter mechanics (`resume_args`, `notice_delivery`, `steer`, `interrupt_keys`, ...) | 6 (`kind`, `model`, `effort`, `args`, `attribution`, `fallback`) | [O] same |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-387- | Shared fields | none | none | [O] same |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-388- | Owner | Posse; built-in defaults cover the supported harnesses | the User | [O] report section E |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-396- ### 5.3 Why it is still not understandable today, and the fix
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-397- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:398: The User's doubt is justified for a different reason: the word "kind" leaks. It appears in `posse dispatch` output, in `profile_required` help, in the Lead instructions and in `lead.profiles.<kind>`. A reader meets two nouns where only one is a choice.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-399- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-400- - Lead instructions, `posse dispatch`, `posse show` and Notices name the Profile only. The harness appears as an attribute of the Profile (`harness: codex`), never as something to select.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-430- ### 6.1 Constraints taken as given
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-431- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:432: - [O] "A role skill listed in `[skills]` is required. ... There is no setting to relax this." (`docs/skills.md`). The User chose enforcement after advice and a warning did not change Worker behaviour (report D2, commit `6bd85306`). This design keeps "selected means required" and fixes fit instead.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-433- - [O] ADR 0036 removed Lead skills from Workers because they "cost context, invited misfires and lengthened launch commands". A per-Task channel must not reopen that.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-434- - [O] Making a skill available costs its name and description; the body loads on use. The cost that hurts is the mandatory invocation of a skill that does not fit (report D2: `posse-tdd` on a docs-only Task).
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-460- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-461- 1. The Worker platform skill `posse`. The Lead-only and User-only platform skills (`posse-setup`, `posse-down`, `posse-update`) are not loaded into Workers (report J8).
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:462: 2. The set the Brief names. Without one: the set for the stated Outcome (`change` for `outcome: change`, `research` for `outcome: report`). For an `open` Task under `default = "auto"`, both sets are made available and each is required only if its step is reached (6.3).
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-463- 3. Allowlisted skills from the Brief.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-464- 4. The Profile's skills.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-466- **Defaults need no config edit.** Today's `[skills] change = [...]` and `research = [...]` are read as the sets `change` and `research`. `[skills] review` is used by the built-in reviewer until it leaves.
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-467- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:468: ### 6.3 A selected skill is required at the step the Task reaches
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-469- 
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-470- Each skill has a step. [O] The step map already exists in code (`internal/app/skill_uses.go:28-36`). The design moves it into the skill's own metadata and limits steps to three moments Posse can observe:
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-573- |---|---|---|---|
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-574- | T-1 | Route every type branch through the plan accessor. Add a test that fails on a new `Type ==` branch outside the compatibility package | no behaviour change; the full E2E suite is the proof | revert the commit |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:575: | T-2 | `outcome:` accepted in Briefs; `type:` becomes an alias and stops being required; plan gains `open`. One `done` check by Outcome | a Brief with a body and `done_when` starts a Worker | old Briefs keep working unchanged; stop writing new-version plans by a release revert while none is live, otherwise let live ones finish first |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-576- | T-3 | Skill sets, allowlist, Brief `skills:`, Profile `skills`, step-bound requirement. Role keys read as sets | AC-S1 to AC-S3 | config keys are additive; unset them |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-577- | T-4 | Profile `description` and `only_for`; `--because` stored and shown; harness wording in output | AC-K1, AC-P1 | additive keys; unset them |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-630- | `[[dispatch]] type = ...` | read as an Outcome scope (section 5.4) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-631- | `defaults.review`, `review_loop.max_rounds`, `block_at` | kept; they configure the Delivery's Verdict requirement and Fix Round budget |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md:632: | `review_loop.profile`, `auto_start`, `[skills] review`, `type = "review"` rules | used by the built-in provider; at R-1 they fail with `config_migration_required` naming `review_provider`, as the removed `no-mistakes` mode does today ([O] `CONTEXT.md`, Merge Mode) |
2026-11-13-direction-2-design.md-633- | Removed commands | fail with an error that names the replacement |
